limits: The setup wrote a synthetic platform/native-OpenAI fixture; measurements used one candidate on an owned PostgreSQL 18 backend.
Original SQL, parameters and returned rows were captured through the actual public scheduler; only authority_now is normalized in non-clock facts hashes.
Each original transaction used a fresh READ COMMITTED read-only snapshot. No original advisory fence exists in this reader.
EXPLAIN was supplementary; context work and extra database-clock brackets are excluded from target wall measurements.
These per-query microdiagnostics do not prove end-to-end latency, catalog-scale behavior or production sellability.
